note: Human-reviewed GENUINE MULTI-THESIS AUTHORS. analysis/build_thesis_facts.py's `resolve_author_conflicts` enforces "one CISUC `people` row authors at most one thesis in this corpus", and that rule is what keeps "Martins, Pedro" (2014, computer vision) and "Martins, Pedro Miguel de Oliveira" (2016, ETL) two students instead of one. At university scale it is occasionally wrong about a real person: Estudo Geral holds both the MSc dissertation and the doctoral thesis of the same graduate, filed under the identical author string, and the gate withdraws BOTH links because nothing in a name can tell "the same person twice" from "two people who collide". Every entry here is that distinction made by a human against citable records, with the evidence written down — exactly like data/person_aliases.json and data/person_full_names.json, and for the same reason: the alternative is a rule ("byte-identical claims are safe"), and byte-identical is the MAXIMALLY similar pair of claims in a corpus whose core trap is that similarity is not identity. An entry creates no match: analysis/name_match.py never sees this file, both claims were already resolved independently on the names alone, and all an entry does is stop the corpus-wide pass from withdrawing them. The handle list is EXHAUSTIVE and is the evidence for the count — a claim on an exempted slug for a handle not listed here is demoted exactly as it is today, because the reviewed fact says that is somebody else. analysis/multi_thesis_authors.py re-proves every claim on every build and breaks it when one goes stale. See analysis/multi_thesis_authors.py and docs/thesis-attribution.md.

entries.evidence: One human, two deposits: the MSc dissertation he finished first and the doctoral thesis he finished five years later, both filed by Estudo Geral under the identical creator string "Campos, João Rodrigues de". Read off the two OAI records directly on 2026-10-18 (https://estudogeral.uc.pt/oai/request, verb=GetRecord, oai_dc): 10316/83144 is `info:eu-repo/semantics/masterThesis`, "Dissertação de Mestrado em Engenharia Informática apresentada à Faculdade de Ciências e Tecnologia", dated 2017-07-11, contributor "Costa, Ernesto Jorge Fernandes"; 10316/100421 is `info:eu-repo/semantics/doctoralThesis`, "Tese de Doutoramento no Programa de Doutoramento em Ciências e Tecnologias de Informação", dated 2022-01-27, contributors "Vieira, Marco" and "Costa, Ernesto Jorge Fernandes" — so the two records are different degrees, not a duplicated deposit, and the MSc supervisor carried into the PhD. Corroborated by the person himself rather than only by the repository: his own CV page http://joaorcampos.com lists "M.Sc. in Informatics Engineering, with a specialization in Intelligent Systems" at Coimbra for 2015-2017 and a 2022 "Ph.D., 'Advanced Online Failure Prediction Through Machine Learning'" — a PhD title identical to 10316/100421's. CISUC publishes him as "João Rodrigues Campos", Integrated Researcher and CS-Lab group leader in Software and Systems Engineering, email local part `jrcampos`, ORCID 0000-0002-4623-764X, linking that same personal page (re-fetched 2026-10-18); dependability and online failure prediction are that group's own subject. Both claims are token-set-equal to the CISUC row ({campos, joao, rodrigues} either way), which is why the gate found two set-equality claimants, could prefer neither, and demoted both.
entries.note: The MSc (10316/83144) is in this corpus even though `masterThesis` is outside the harvest's doctoral filter: its OAI sets are com_10316_15517 / col_10316_15518, neither of which is in estudo_geral_extractor.oai.HARVEST_SETS. It was added by hand while this conflict was being investigated. If a future harvest re-run drops it, this entry goes stale and the build will say so.
